youtube.script: Could one prompt trigger the wrong action? OpenAI said it trained GPT-Red and used it to harden GPT-5.6 against prompt injection. The takeaway is practical: once AI can browse files, use tools, or touch business systems, safety has to live inside the workflow. So if AI can send money, publish content, or expose private data, add a human approval step before anything irreversible happens. That one control is boring, but it prevents a lot of cleanup later. Where would you place your first approval step: payments, publishing, or file access? Drop your answer in the comments, and tell me if you want a simple approval checklist next.
